text: Hinoo jortaa nde Joomi mon yurmina on -onon yo ɓiɗɓe Israa’iila- ɓaawo ɗee lepte saɗtuɗe si on tuubanii Mo, on moƴƴinii golle mon ɗen. Si on ruttike non e bonnere nden laawol tataɓol maa ko ɓuri,Men ruttoto e leptugol on. Men waɗini mon Jahannama ndaɗɗudi ɓen yedduɓe Alla,ɓe seedataa e magge.
